paper_metadata.title: Ageing characteristics and high-temperature tensile properties of Al–Si–Cu–Mg alloys with micro-additions of Mo and Mn

evidence.quote: Artificial ageing characteristics and high temperature tensile properties of the Al -7Si-1Cu-0.5Mg (wt.%) alloy modified with micro-additions of Mo and Mn, were examined.

The experimental alloys were prepared in an induction furnace by melting commercial master alloys of Al-50Cu, Al-35Si, Al-10Mn, Al-6.1Mo in wt.% and pure metals, Al and Mg to achieve the selected alloy chemistry, as listed in Table 1. As the reference base, the Al-Si-Cu-Mg alloy without additions of Mo and Mn was used.
